# தமிழ்க் களஞ்சியம் · Tamil Kalanjiyam

A bilingual (Tamil and English) treasury of Tamil history, language, literature, culture, arts, games, festivals and knowledge, with a searchable catalogue of 228 literary works, interactive pieces and an age-wise learning path.

- `index.html` is the whole site in one file. GitHub Pages serves it as is.
- `src/parts` (Tamil) and `src/parts-en` (English) hold the chapter sources; `python3 src/build.py` rebuilds `index.html`.

**Generated by AI.** All text was written by Claude (Anthropic) in November 2026 and has not been reviewed by subject experts. The English edition is an AI translation of the Tamil. Check facts against the sources listed at the foot of each chapter.
